title: Chapter 971
paragraphs: Chapter 971
Episode 240. Crisis of the Red Plutonian Tribe (4)
When Rakiman's Patlok successfully occupied Piruol, Bakarun was attacking Meisil in the same way.
Massive spatial leaps, followed by battlefield erosion through successive Jeoknoe waves.
In particular, Pibil was an even more advanced weapon than Patlok, as it was an aerial fortress operated by the strongest dueling king, utilizing much more superior technology.
Ailan Vermont was staring at the sky of Meisil, which had turned red.
“I never thought I would see such a sky in Meisil......”
The Jeoknoe waves spewed from Pibil had already stained the ground red. Just like in Piruol, all the communication devices and dimension gates in Meisil had lost their function.
Negotiations would be impossible. There was no reason for the Red Plutonian Tribe, who had planned to betray them from the beginning, to propose negotiations to the Imperial Court.
Kwaahhhhh...!
The bombardment from Pibil and the fleet began. The Mains, who had hastily entered a combat stance, were obliterated without even swinging their swords.
The ancient Myeongwang Tribe did not conquer the underworld merely with their overwhelming force unique to their race.
It was indeed their overwhelming technological power that made the Myeongwang Tribe of that time a symbol of terror.
To the Red Plutonian Tribe, the Imperial Court's biological weapons were nothing more than crude weapons. They were not incredibly powerful, nor intelligent, nor irreplaceably special.

“The one who calls himself the Emperor of the Inse Empire, Ailan Vermont. You were lucky to have the opportunity to exploit the great Red Plutonian Tribe, but all you managed to create were these crude weapons......”
Bakarun's voice was being clearly transmitted from the bridge of Pibil to the inside of Meisil Fortress.

Ailan felt a bitter taste rising within him. He thought that he had completed Mains that could even match the ground forces of the world's great powers, but by the standards of the Red Plutonian Tribe in their heyday, it was nothing more than a failure.
“I forgot for a moment because I had subjugated them too easily. What the Red Plutonian Tribe was.”
The difference in status between the Red Plutonian and Melkajok tribes of that time could not be overstated, even when compared to the gap between the founding and ordinary knights.
Although the Red Plutonian Tribe had been repeatedly beaten by the great powers since awakening from their seal, they were essentially once-in-a-lifetime conquerors.
When the Red Plutonian and Blue Plutonian tribes were in their prime, all the Masin of Jinma-gye held their breath, and even the great serpent Amerisma tried to avoid head-on battles if possible.
"No, Your Majesty. It's my fault. If Manof and I had been more careful, they wouldn't have dared betray us like this."
"By now, Manof's location in Piruol must also be under attack. And today is the time when most of the Blue Plutonian clan's buried members have been transferred to Piruol... our luck is bad."
Bivol had nothing to say.
No matter how much he thought, he couldn't come up with a clever way to resolve this situation. Saying, "I will protect you," would be laughable when it seemed impossible.
"Bivol, it seems you and I must be the only ones to survive."
"Your Majesty?"
The other royal family members raised their heads.
Airan was thinking of abandoning them. To survive, no, to slightly increase the odds of survival, it had to be done.

"Our grand plan has failed. After today, we must hide and watch for opportunities just as we did before, until the treacherous Red Plutonian clan disappears, and Zipple and Runcandel are annihilated and forgotten by the world. But waiting is what we do best."
If it was just himself, Bivol, and Temar Vermont, it would be entirely possible.
To abandon the opportunity to rule the world alone that had come so close was painful, but as long as they didn't die, they could dream again someday.
The subjects looked momentarily confused but soon kneeled.
"Please preserve your noble body, Your Majesty."
"Please preserve your noble body!"

The subjects drew their swords and moved towards the fortress's exit. Since they were all in a specially strengthened state using Temar's information, they would hold out a bit longer than the Mains before dying.

"Wake Eltiot and cause it to rampage. That should buy us enough time to escape. Fortunately, the attacking flying fortress is only one... it appears to be fully operational, but it must have been short on blood, so its operating time will be limited. It might last about three or four hours."

Although it had weakened since the days before its seal, when it was a god, Eltiot fundamentally possessed the power of Genesis. It should be able to tie up the flying fortress and fleet on its own for a few hours.
"Understood, Your Majesty."
Bivol moved towards Eltiot's seal room. The emperor looked at the Main standing next to him, Temar Vermont.
"Temar Vermont, can you protect us?"
"I will."
"You don't seem certain."
"It depends on how long Eltiot holds out. If it falls before the flying fortress's firepower weakens, it will become dangerous."
"What if you awaken the memories remaining in your left arm?"
The real Temar Runcandel's left arm, that was Airan's greatest hope.
"I'm not sure about that. I can't know exactly what level my original ability is at. But it will certainly be better than it is now."
"Indeed."
Kwaaaah-!
Suddenly, an explosion from the top of the fortress sent a surge of bluish lightning. The lightning caused by Eltiot's rampage instantly wiped out part of Bakarun's fleet hovering overhead.
"Your Majesty, it is done!"
"Good, let's go."

Airan and the rest began to run towards the fortress's back door. The underground passage was already eroded by the enemy's wave and unusable, and even if it were intact, it would be meaningless. Evading the aerial fortress's detection was impossible.
Rather, the decision was to leave Meisil as quickly as possible through the development area while Eltiot held out.
'Escaping will not be hard if we can just get away. But if we get caught... we need to think about what to do then.'
Running away from the enemies right now doesn't mean the crisis is over.
The moment the situation became known externally, not just the Vamel Alliance but all the great forces would pursue them. Everyone had a reason to want Temar's left arm.
'In that case, negotiations with the Vamel Alliance will be impossible... and dealing with Zipple is dangerous. I guess we have to rely on Kinzelo
. Ridiculous... enough.'
Behind the fleeing Airan and the others, red and blue lightning was mixing incessantly.
Sure enough, as soon as Eltiot escaped from the seal room, he caught Bakarun's attention. The sudden appearance of the Blue Plutonian's deity would have surprised even Bakarun.
"......Eltiot! The Melka clan had the Blue Plutonian deity! But he's not in good shape, we can suppress him with concentrated firepower from Pivil and the entire fleet."
"Bakarun brother, Airan Bimant is escaping. Part of the fleet should chase them..."

"No, we can't deal with Airan's body golem with ordinary fleets. Ignore that and focus on Eltiot! If we can suppress him without destroying his heart, his blood will be incomparable to anything else!"

Even the calm and composed Bakarun could not hide his excitement. If they could obtain the blood of the Blue Plutonian's deity, it wasn't entirely impossible to partly recreate the true heyday of the enemies.
"Understood, Bakarun brother!"
All the main guns of the aerial fortress and fleet were aimed at Eltiot.
[Enemies... Enemies... you...!]
Even though he had lost his sanity, Eltiot did not forget his enmity towards the enemies.
To him, the dying Meisil Fortress looked like the ancient fortress of Blue Plutonian, and the dying mines appeared like his Blue Plutonian brothers.
If it had been the divine warrior Eltiot in perfect condition, a single air fortress would have been enough for him to handle on his own.

However, it was too much for Eltiot at the moment. The power emitted by Eltiot was enough to change the blood-red sky to blue and still remain, but it wasn't sharp enough to corner Bakarun. The Huang clan, who had rushed out to preserve the jade body, were utterly wiped out without a trace from its aftermath.
"Your Majesty, they are coveting Eltiot! We might be able to escape at this rate."
If they could cross just one plain, there would be a dimensional gate that was still functional.

However, Ailan and his party were engulfed in a feeling of unease. They could understand the Rednaim tribe coveting Eltiot's blood, but they couldn't figure out why they would be neglected to this extent.
That unease soon became reality.
Tsuhaaaaaak-!

Suddenly, the ground the Ailan party was running on collapsed like a pile of sand. Temar Vermont defended Ailan from the shock wave that suddenly spread all around, and Bibol stared into the air with a desperate face.
A huge red dimensional gate was opening across the plain. The ground had just collapsed because of the shock created by the opening of the dimensional gate.
"Pa, Patlok..."
Bibol gasped.
From within the dimensional gate, the air fortress Patlok of the Rednaim Tribe's third city was emerging.
"Why would Brother Bakarun let you go? Ailan. It was because we had already finished off Piruol and were in a position to come here."
The top of Patlok opened to reveal a large window, and Shimat's face was revealed. Shimat's face, as it appeared in the window, looked down at the Ailan party.
The Ailan party had no choice but to stop. It was a moment when even a glimmer of hope had vanished, as they had no answer when only Pibil was there.
Moreover, Patlok was in an even more stable state, utilizing the blood of the Blue Plutonian tribe that had been in Piruol.
"This guy doesn't seem to want to tell us where our divine warrior is to the very end."
Shimat said, lifting Manof's head. Manof was in a state of not dying, with only his head left, using part of the undead army's technology.
"Heuk, Your, Majesty."
"Manof..."
Soon, Shimat threw Manof's head somewhere and locked eyes with Ailan.

"Ailan Vermont, I clearly gave Manof the opportunity to become our slave. But since Manof didn't open his mouth, becoming a slave with all limbs intact is out of the question now. Eventually, the whereabouts of the divine brothers will be dug out slowly after only your heads are left..."
As Shimat grinned, Temar Vermont drew his sword.
